title: Helpfull Creeper Mod
description: A mod that lets you undo Creeper explosions and leaves an apology sign.
body:
# Helpful Creeper 💥🛡️

Have you ever spent hours building a beautiful house, only for a Creeper to sneak up behind you and blow it to pieces? We all have!

**Helpful Creeper** is a lightweight, server-and-client side Fabric mod that gives you a second chance!

## ✨ Features

* **Interactive Undo Screen:** Whenever a Creeper explodes near you, a custom GUI will instantly pop up asking if you want to restore the damaged area.
* **Instant Restoration:** Click "Yes, Please" and watch the blocks magically return to their original state, complete with particles and sounds.
* **An Apologetic Creeper:** After fixing the mess, the mod will automatically place a sign at the center of the explosion, facing you, with a little note: *"Sorry!! -Creeper"*. 

## ⚙️ Technical Details

* **Mod Loader:** Fabric
* **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.11
* **Requirement:** Must be installed on the Client to work properly.

## 🤝 Open Source & Free

This mod was created as a completely free project for the Minecraft community. You are welcome to use it in your modpacks! Feel free to check out the source code or report issues on the linked GitHub repository.
